bullets.text: At least 39 migrants died after a boat bound for Europe sank off the coast of Senegal, highlighting the dangers of the Atlantic crossing to Spain's Canary Islands.
A collision between two trains in al-Ayyat, Egypt, resulted in at least seven deaths and 125 injuries, prompting a presidential investigation.
The leader of a Kenyan doomsday sect was sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murder of 190 children and one adult, who were ordered to starve themselves.

Queensland is launching a 'life changing' initiative to close the homelessness gap by providing transitional housing in 37 projects statewide, expected to deliver over 600 places for those sleeping rough.

A major report reveals how alleged rape victims are treated in Queensland, with prosecutors dropping cases because survivors 'didn’t act how a rape victim should', according to an Australian Institute of Criminology review of 19,000 sexual assault cases.

The NSW Bureau of Crime Statistics and Research found that Aboriginal children are 30 per cent less likely to receive a court diversion from police compared to non-Aboriginal children, highlighting disparities in the justice system.

Nvidia is investigating an alleged Chinese spy scandal involving an individual linked to its chief executive who pitched AI chip deals. Shares in the chipmaker have fallen amid the probe, raising questions about CEO Jensen Huang's future leadership.

US natural gas futures have seen their largest surge in six weeks, jumping by over 8%, driven by forecasts of cooler weather along the Atlantic seaboard. This upward push has triggered a short squeeze, forcing hedge funds to unwind positions.

China has successfully priced its debut yuan-denominated green bond in Canada, attracting robust demand. This move expands China's offshore debt footprint, aiming to finance sustainable projects and bolster ties between the two nations.
